newsitem.title: POLAND: Zloty unchanged vs basket, depos slightly up.
newsitem.headline: Zloty unchanged vs basket, depos slightly up.

text.p: The Polish zloty finished the light trading session flat against the basket of currencies after limited foreign currency sales were balanced by importers orders, dealers said.
"Small currency-sales might have been foreign orders but were covered by importer orders," said Marek Wieczorkowski, dealer at Kredyt Bank SA.

The zloty closed flat from Monday's close at 2.92/2.87 percent from the trading band centre. It was at 3.0855/65 to the dollar, down from 3.0830/50 on Monday and at 1.8080/95 to the mark, down from 1.8062/72.
Deposit rates were balanced with a slight tendency to trade higher in the afternoon after central bank drainage operations.

Overnight rates were quoted at 21.71/21.90 percent, up 0.1 point from opening's 21.60/21.80 percent after the central bank sold 306 million zlotys worth of 91- and 273-day NBP-bills at flat average yields of 22.00 percent.
Tomorrow/next rates were at 21.65/21.95 percent against opening's 21.65/21.85 percent after the central bank drained 167 million zlotys for 14 days at 21.65 percent.
